sections.intro: 48 vault/test table pairs were checked and 34 raised at least one flag (58 flag lines in all). Some flags are expected by chance across this many checks. A flag means only that the sign of a group's mean differs between the two periods (or that the group-order trends have opposite signs). Median absolute group mean over the groups with a flag (both periods pooled) versus over all checked groups: probability gap (table family A) 0.0075 versus 0.0708 (3 flagged of 18 groups); mean net $ per trade (run tables) 0.0456 versus 0.1899 (53 flagged of 277 groups). Flags raised by a fixed rule (opposite sign of the headline metric for a group with at least 30 trades or events on both sides, or opposite-signed trends over the group order with |rho| >= 0.5 on both sides). No judgement is attached; an empty list means none of the checked tables raised a flag.
